Called three times per textured vertex (once per triangle corner) from the constructor's texture-type-3 UV-derivation branch, alongside method1885 (type 1) and NodeDequeStatics.method1991 (type 2) as the type-3 sibling. `unused`/i_6_ is never read in the body - a further decoy/unused parameter. On exception, rethrows via TextureLoadException with a formatted arg dump referencing this method as 'qb.E' in the original obfuscated class/method name.
